entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse monitor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number? And just to be clear, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
The name is Sarah Smith, order 99428. And it's not broken, if that's what you mean. It's just... confusing.
Okay, Sarah, I've pulled up your account. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th. Can you tell me a little more about what you're finding confusing?
The whole interface is just hard to use. I read the user manual, but it didn't help. I guess I just expected more for what I paid.
I understand your frustration. When you say the interface is hard to use, are you referring to navigating the menus on the band itself or in the VeloFit app?
Both. Look, I don't want a tutorial. I just want to send it back.
Of course. My apologies. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, Sarah, I've checked our policy. I see you received the item 26 days ago, and you are well within the 90-day return window.
Fine. So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I can process that return for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label and it will be sent to the email address we have on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes.
Whatever. Just make sure it actually shows up.
It will. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day, Sarah.
